items.passage: Transcript: Hi, this is Ezra Halvorsen at the campus observatory. Our open viewing nights normally run Fridays from eight to eleven, in the dome on the roof of the Kestrel Building, and anyone can just show up. Next Friday is the lunar eclipse, so that night works differently. Students in an astronomy course get the dome, from nine to midnight, and they need to sign up by Thursday. Everyone else is still welcome, but you will be on the lawn behind the building with the club's portable telescopes, from seven to ten. If you plan to take photos with your phone, you will need a red filter over the screen so you do not ruin everyone's night vision. We have forty, and we are handing them out Wednesday afternoon in Room 359, not at the door on the night. If it is cloudy, both sessions are off and we will livestream instead. Questions go to extension 3067.
